Home.tagline: I write software, built to last.
Home.intro: Close to a decade of building across industries and architectures — and still loving the building and the learning.
Home.note: a few things I care about ↓
Home.bandBody: I live in Austin, build things for the web and beyond, and hold a doctorate in music — a background that still shapes how I think about craft, practice, and performance.

work.title: Work
work.body: I'm a software engineer with close to a decade of experience across a wide variety of industries and architectural concerns. My software supports robotics, financial transactions, animations across the internet, and skyscrapers.

life.title: Life
life.body: In addition to software, I stay active with my hobbies and my family. Krav maga, fly fishing, cloud architecture, and wine are my current pursuits. My wife and I love to travel--Colorado holds a special place in our hearts.

study.title: Study
study.body: My formal education is in music: I hold a doctorate (DMA) from UT Austin, where my research was in performance psychology as it applied to vocal pedagogy, Schubert, and Mozart. Other degrees: MM Voice - University of Cincinnati, and BM Voice, cum laude, Baylor University.

Blog.title: Blog
Blog.englishOnly: Blog posts are available in English only.
